name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'very next move picks it back up' (holding_box on the very next step after each fall, and box_fell can never occur on the episode's final step, so the next step always exists). Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures 'if you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands': at_exit holds only on the last step, so the Response is satisfied exactly when the box is held at the exit. Both clauses are conditional rules ('should the box fall', 'if you get to the exit'), so the rule-only warning with no FINAL_STATES is valid, and both are hard since no preference cue appears.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the very next step.
If the agent is at the exit, the agent must be holding the box.
